queries:
WITH per_type AS (
  SELECT MediaTypeId,
         AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS ratio,
         COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM Track
  WHERE Bytes > 10323804
  GROUP BY MediaTypeId
)
SELECT CAST(MediaTypeId AS TEXT) AS MediaTypeId, ratio, cnt FROM per_type
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Summary', AVG(ratio), AVG(cnt) FROM per_type
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE Bytes >= 10323804;
SELECT m.Name, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS ratio
FROM Track t
JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE Bytes > 10000000 AND Bytes IS NOT NULL AND Milliseconds > 0;
